Log: Create a logger. `debug()` and `info()` write to standard output, and `warn()`, `error()`, and `fatal()` to standard error, one line per call. `colors` defaults to whether both standard output and standard error are TTYs. Fixed in v2.0.5: if something in the process had made standard output or standard error non-blocking, as libuv does when it opens a stream on one, lines written while the pipe was full went missing or were cut short.
LogOptions: Options for `Log`. `colors` forces ANSI color styling on or off in formatted output.
Log.colors: Whether this logger applies ANSI color styling to formatted output. Read-only.
Log.format: Formats `data` the same way `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`, and `fatal` do, and returns the resulting string without logging it.
Log.clear: Clears the log output. A no-op on the base `Log`.
CompositeLog: Create a logger that forwards every call to each logger in `logs`, so a single log call can write to, for example, both the console and a file.
